 Welterweight veterans reportedly set for UFC Dallas clash
 Sayan Nag Nov 13, 2026 
 The 
Ultimate Fighting Championship ’s first event of 2027 is
gradually taking shape.
 Geoff
Neal and Chris
Curtis are reportedly set to collide at UFC
Dallas on Jan. 16 at American Airlines Center.
 Advertisement 
 Geoff Neal and Chris Curtis look to get back on track in
Dallas
According to Marcel Dorff , Neal and Curtis will clash at UFC
Dallas, the UFC’s first event of 2027.
Neal (16-8) has dropped four of his last five bouts, with the only
win coming against Rafael dos
Anjos due to an injury. While “Handz of Steel” was scheduled to
fight Chidi
Njokuani at UFC
330 this past August, he pulled out due to an undisclosed
injury.
Meanwhile, Curtis (32-13, 1 NC) has lost three of his last four
bouts. “The Action Man” is coming off a decision defeat to
Myktykbek Orolbai.
 Geoff Neal 
vs. Chris
Curtis #UFCDallas - January 16th. https://t.co/7YfFIfrORP
